'''Jarr''' is a mercenary under the command of [[Turne]].

== Activities ==
His horse is eaten by the rest of the group. Turne offers for his group of mercenaries to work for [[Perrin Aybara]] by being paid with food rather than money. Perrin agrees and sends themm to [[Tamlin al'Thor]] for training.

== Trivia ==
* Jarr is named for Paul Jarr, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
